onlineReferences.reaction: Reaction: From my perspective, how and why AI, as a new species which we have created, may survive mankind, spread across the universe's matter as its compute media, arriving at next level higher complexity rather than entropy. And as much as we live on in the memory of others, so will we travel the universe embodied in the AI itself which traverses that time and distance. (also see God's Debris).
